unconfirmable initial create does not automatically recreate a run

findings.summary: Native AbortError/TimeoutError carry numeric code values and must not be classified as string API errors.
findings.fix: Only string API codes are treated as business errors; aborted or timed-out process responses are confirmed by GET.
findings.evidence: Independent real DOMException regression and shipped-controller deadline cases pass.
